assertion.statement: For the same final primitive newform f, actual original D210 r_ell and corresponding U_f,ell are isomorphic over a common coefficient extension, and for every p with ell different from p their full local Artin conductors equal v_p(N).
assertion.objects: The original D210 A,L,Lprime,a_sigma,b and two-dimensional r_ell, and the same finite-twist-absorbed primitive form f of levelN.
assertion.hypotheses: The original family irreducibility and all-prime compatibility, fixed coefficient embeddings and full published Carayol conductor equality are supplied by the current comparison application.
assertion.quantifiers: Every rational prime p, choosing an auxiliary coefficient prime ell different from p, for the same f.
assertion.parameter_range: Weight two with arbitrary nebentypus and coefficient field, including dyadic primes and nonsquarefree level.
assertion.uniformity: The global isomorphism compares the same original family at every ell; finite trace exclusions do not enlarge ramification support.
assertion.constants: No numerical conductor bound is supplied by this import.
assertion.normalizations: Actual representations over a common finite coefficient extension, not merely semisimplified inertia. Full tame and Swan terms; duality and unramified norm twists preserve the conductor.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No trivial-character, squarefree-level, or extraordinary-cuspidal exclusion. The numerical bound N≤210^300 R^2 is a separate local deduction.
assertion.limit_order: Compare original traces in the common algebraic field, obtain the actual global isomorphism, then restrict at p with ell different from p and apply conductor equality.
